newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Privredna Banka rejects bids for assets.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Privredna Banka rejects bids for assets.

text.p: Croatia's prime rehabilitation candidate, Privredna Banka Zagreb, said on Tuesday it rejected bids in a tender for assets in companies from its portfolio.
Privredna said in its newsletter it would repeat a tender for a 100 percent stake in a small electronic firm RIZ, priced at 80,074 marks, which attracted three bidders.
At the end of October it advertised for sale the stakes in 20 firms acquired in debt-for-equity swaps.
But apart from RIZ only five other firms, including department store chain NAMA and publisher of the influential daily newspaper Vjesnik, attracted any interest before the tender closed last month.
Privredna rejected these and two other bids for its minority holdings in furniturer maker Gaj and trading firm Laguna Commerce.
It said it would consider a bid for the resin factory Chromos-Tvornica Smola, in which it has 10.66 percent but gave no prices.
The bank plans to sell all its assets save for those in tourist firms in a move to help its restructuring and overhaul. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
